decisions: Original fictional passages assess family cooperation, support for a late-arriving sibling and negotiation of a shared book. No copied exam question or university exercise.
Selected kinship vocabulary checked against university teaching material; its wider social/inheritance generalisations are not adopted. The school curriculum supplies the exact-class objective scope.
Source heading Ikwunibe retained. English short labels are author paraphrases, not official codes or complete kinship translations.
Reading accuracy, vocabulary clarification, text evidence, inference and actual discussion are separated. One plan remains future, not a witnessed completed action.
Word-newness varies by learner; record requested clarification rather than claiming every selected word is unfamiliar.
Underdots retained and equivalent meaningful forms accepted after examiner checking. Native linguistic review, tone/reference pronunciation and marking calibration remain pending.
Four spoken tasks require actual live or recorded evidence; no recording or classroom performance has occurred.
Family-role examples are context-specific, not universal gender duties or a required household structure. No real personal family information is required.
